events.what_it_is: A three-day Conair and Lil Sweet Treat pop-up celebrating new Cake Pop Hair Dryer colorways with sweets, photo moments and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Sweet treats, special giveaways and hair accessories are advertised while supplies last. Cake Pop Hair Dryer giveaways are tied to purchase for the first 100 qualifying visitors each day.
events.caveats: Open public pop-up. Hair accessories and other giveaways are while supplies last. The Cake Pop Hair Dryer offer requires purchase and must not be represented as an unconditional freebie.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20 at 184 7th Ave S. Current NYC listing gives 11 AM–11 PM on Sept. 18; later-day closing times were not independently established strongly enough in this pass, so only the verified opening time is preserved for Sept. 19–20.

events.what_it_is: A two-day Brown Bee collaboration at Pura Vida's Nolita location pairing smoothies with beauty-product giveaways.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 qualifying visitors are advertised to receive a PB Smoothie, a full-size product and an exclusive Brown Bee gift.
events.caveats: The giveaway is explicitly limited to the first 100 visitors and should not be presented as guaranteed for later arrivals. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the current listing.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–19 at Pura Vida Nolita, 98 Kenmare St. Current listing gives 10 AM–6 PM for Sept. 18; Sept. 19 hours were not independently established strongly enough in this pass, so the second occurrence is retained without an invented closing time.
